# GENERATED by scripts/kehillah_holiday_revision_build.py.
# Everyone includes courtiers. Using only this engine hook avoids giving
# rulers a second annual draw. A queued scene has one monthly callback.
random_yearly_everyone_pulse = { on_actions = { jewish_holiday_resume_pending_pulse jewish_holiday_yearly_pulse } }
jewish_holiday_resume_pending_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        NOT = { jewish_holiday_no_pending_trigger = yes }
        NOT = { has_character_flag = jewish_holiday_calendar_running }
    }
    effect = {
        add_character_flag = jewish_holiday_calendar_running
        trigger_event = { on_action = jewish_holiday_calendar_pulse months = 1 }
    }
}

jewish_holiday_yearly_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        is_jewish_character_trigger = yes
        is_adult = yes
        is_imprisoned = no
        jewish_holiday_no_pending_trigger = yes
    }
    effect = {
        random = {
            chance = {
                value = 12
                if = { limit = { is_ai = no } value = 60 }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_ritual_celebrations }
                            has_personal_tenet = tenet_ritual_celebrations
                        }
                    }
                    value = 16
                    if = { limit = { is_ai = no } value = 75 }
                }
            }
            random_list = {
                20 = { trigger = { jewish_holiday_scene_0001_eligible_trigger = yes } trigger_event = jewish_holidays.0101 }
                20 = { trigger = { jewish_holiday_scene_0002_eligible_trigger = yes } trigger_event = jewish_holidays.0102 }
                20 = { trigger = { jewish_holiday_scene_0003_eligible_trigger = yes } trigger_event = jewish_holidays.0103 }

                20 = { trigger = { jewish_holiday_scene_0008_eligible_trigger = yes } trigger_event = jewish_holidays.0108 }
                20 = { trigger = { jewish_holiday_scene_0009_eligible_trigger = yes } trigger_event = jewish_holidays.0109 }
                20 = { trigger = { jewish_holiday_scene_0010_eligible_trigger = yes } trigger_event = jewish_holidays.0110 }
                20 = { trigger = { jewish_holiday_scene_0011_eligible_trigger = yes } trigger_event = jewish_holidays.0111 }
